prompt: A pencil sketch with light color wash depicts a quiet theatre backstage. On the left, a man in a red scarf sits on a wooden crate, his posture slumped in exhaustion. Next to him stands a tall woman in a blue dress, who is pointing toward the center of the room where a large mirror leans against the wall. In the center, a young boy in a yellow shirt looks at his reflection in the glass, adjusting his collar with careful hands. To the right, an old prop sword rests on a dusty table, its hilt wrapped in faded leather. Beside the table, a black cat sleeps curled into a tight ball, ignoring the activity around it. The woman in the blue dress is handing a script to the man in the red scarf, who reaches out to take it. There is no audience visible in this private moment behind the curtains. The scene captures the stillness before the performance begins, with soft hues blending into the graphite lines to suggest depth and atmosphere without overwhelming the delicate structural details of the setting.
